description: An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential search is for a visionary leader committed to upholding the highest standards of resident care and operational excellence.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. Your leadership will be crucial in driving quality outcomes, optimizing financial performance, and enhancing community relations.This role offers a competitive salary range of $115,000 to $145,000 per year, reflecting the importance of this leadership position. We are seeking a professional who is ready to make a significant impact and contribute to a culture of compassionate care and continuous improvement.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated success in operational management, financial oversight, and quality improvement initiatives.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
